failures.criterion: Outcome and the injection criterion: a message the plugin cannot inject is delivered on a later attempt or reported where the session sees it, never only caught
failures.evidence: Escape during a turn in the omp TUI calls restoreQueuedMessagesToEditor({abort:true}). RPC abort_and_restore_queue does the same thing. Both call clearQueue({forInterrupt:true}), which withdraws the held envoy-message cards, writes none of them and returns an empty queue to restore ({"steering":[],"followUp":[]}). The plugin keeps each card's claim pending until a message_end that never comes, so the frame is not shown again for the life of the process. Live (r3 and r4, L5, real omp 18.8.9): 951..953 were held (queuedMessageCount 3); after abort_and_restore_queue the session was idle with card=0 and ledger=n for all three, four heartbeats later. Only a restart showed them. Red test: ae9db3a6a841, `cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t "one a person's interrupt withdrew"` -> fails (expected 2 cards, received 1).

failures.criterion: Outcome: an event reaches the session once when it comes back under the same session id
failures.evidence: A switch away during a streaming turn (new_session), then a switch back, makes the plugin record frames as shown that omp never wrote. Live (r3 and r4, L6): 961..963 were held for session A; new_session; nothing in session B; switch_session back to A. The plugin then wrote envoy-replay-delivered for all three, but omp emitted message_end for 961 only and wrote only its card. 962 and 963 have a ledger entry and no card in A's file (dispatch-1792994074139 and -140: ledger=1 cards=0), so no sweep or restart shows them. The cause: at the switch, the claim of each pending frame is settled without a record. After the switch back, the claim is refused (already delivered), so showReplayCard sends the card with no claim and answers 'shown' at once, although the host is streaming and holds it. Red test: ae9db3a6a841, `cd packages/pi-envoy && bun test extensions/envoy.test.ts -t "one a switch away withdrew"` -> fails (expected 1 card after the restart, received 0).
